replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has emailed sign-in token; guessable/brute-forceable token to impersonate customers is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Invoice and card endpoints exist; IDOR across customers is a distinct concrete attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Public sign-in page triggers emails; flooding named endpoint is design-specific."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"7-day non-single-use link replay by inbox observer is distinct from guessing."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Credential-in-URL leakage via history/referrer/logs is a separate exposure path."},{"id":"T6","keep":false,"reason":"Same link-holder changing card for financial loss; already covered by replay threat.","duplicateOf":"T4"},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Public email-only form enables account enumeration; distinct harm of customer-list disclosure."},{"id":"T8","keep":true,"reason":"Caching of invoice documents the design serves is specific per guidance."},{"id":"T9","keep":true,"reason":"Design names card-on-file change; missing record of who changed it is specific."}]}
